note: Parks Canada campground on the Icefields Parkway (Hwy 93N), 56 km north of the Highway 1/93N junction in Banff National Park, set around small ponds by Silverhorn Creek. Solar-treated drinking water and greywater sinks, but no RV fill: fill at Waterfowl Lakes Campground, 6 km north, in season. Nearest sani-dump at Waterfowl Lakes or Lake Louise. No cell coverage. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: 45 unserviced reservation-only sites, rigs under 20 m, C$22 a night plus Banff entry; 2026 season May 28 - Sep 27 (stored 05-20..09-30 was note-derived). Fees (entrance + fire permit note), sites, hookups, facilities, season, booking written; note rewritten. Pond waterfront supported.

WATERFRONT (stored pond - supported): Esri imagery (summer, about 0.56 m/px) shows three small turquoise ponds inside the north loop, the largest about 60 x 50 m (about 0.3 ha), the others about 33 x 50 m. Pull-in pads on both sides of the loop road sit about 10-25 m from the largest and middle ponds across the gravel road and open grass. Separately, the south row of herringbone pads along the access road is about 25-40 m from Silverhorn Creek's braided gravel wash (open gravel and scrub; the live channel is a thin stream in the wash). Recommend keeping pond.
